Case ID: 1088
Case Type: Refund
Date: 2025-03-23
Handled By: Customer Support - Miles Turner
Customer or Requestor: Elena Garcia
Title: Order canceled after warehouse stockout

Issue Description
Customer complained that an order was canceled for stock reasons two days after checkout even though the product page continued to show available inventory.

Steps Taken
- Confirmed the cancellation was system-generated after a late warehouse inventory reconciliation.
- Reviewed the order timeline and verified payment capture had already occurred before the cancellation event.
- Escalated to Operations for a same-day refund because the customer had selected expedited shipping for an event date.
- Checked whether a replacement SKU or alternate fulfillment location could salvage the order.

Resolution
Processed a full refund including shipping charges and issued a one-time goodwill credit because the stockout was caused by an internal sync delay.

Follow-Up
Operations and Catalog teams reviewed the inventory feed lag impacting the affected product family.

Reference Documents
- Order Cancellation Playbook v1
- Refund Playbook v2
